text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A murder attempt against Larnaca club owner Antonis Phanieros was committed last night. He was critically injured.
- U.S. State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns says the United States will launch a new initiative on the Cyprus dispute.
- Face-to-face talks on the Cyprus problem are expected to start on July 9.
- (British woman Janette) Pink "insisted on unprotected sex", says her former lover, now accused of transmitting to her the HIV virus.
- Negotiations between opposition parties to field a common presidential candidate reach a deadlock.
- Foreign mediators are now throwing their weight behind encouraging business contacts between the two sides after their failure to break the political deadlock on the Cyprus dispute.
